status: Model retention documented and both registered profile intervals calculated.

model_decision.decision: Retain the registered additive linear OLS specifications.
model_decision.registered_trigger: A clearly documented pattern of curvature or variance misspecification in the prespecified diagnostic review. Record the graphical evidence and intended action before fitting an extension; a smaller scientific p-value is not a trigger.

mean_form.evidence: Residual-versus-fitted bin means remain near zero relative to the residual spread in UDS-only and integrated models. Predictor plots do not show an obvious sustained broad curvature pattern in the observed central support; sparse thickness/age/education tails are less informative. This does not prove an adequate linear mean.
mean_form.judgment: The central residual pattern provides insufficient evidence to add a quadratic thickness term. Sparse tails limit what can be concluded about curvature.

evidence: Scale-location bin means and within-bin residual SDs vary, with somewhat greater spread at the upper fitted end; no dramatic funnel dominates the integrated plot. Constant conditional variance is not established. Retain both the classical and already planned HC3 summaries.

Central Q-Q points are close to the quartile reference, while upper positive tails rise above it and lower tails flatten. Positive residual skewness and excess kurtosis support qualifying exact normal-error calibration rather than declaring normality.
residual_spread_and_tails.judgment: Keep the score in correct-response units and report the prespecified HC3 coefficient companion. The spread and tail patterns qualify the classical interval calibration and give insufficient direction for a specific response transformation.

influence.judgment: Use the full eligible sample for prediction. Interpret the omission fits as sensitivity checks because their membership depends on the observed fit.

model_decision.scope: A judgment about model form for this sample and course analysis. The graphical evidence leaves uncertainty about linearity, constant conditional variance and normal errors, especially in sparse regions. The primary model-based test and its HC3 companion come from the full registered fit.

profile.selection_rule: Among participants with recorded SEX=1, minimize the sum of squared deviations from the common sample's predictor medians, divided by the sample variance of each predictor (denominator n-1). Use age, education and left thickness only. Break distance ties by ascending age, education, then thickness; identical predictor tuples define the same profile. Decimal arithmetic uses 50-digit precision.
profile.target: The conditional mean at this prespecified profile and a new independent eligible participant with the same predictor values; the profile-selection participant's response is not used as a validation observation.
profile.privacy: Record predictor values only; omit participant ID, row index and observed score.

methods.scale_rule: Report the raw OLS limits without rounding scores to integers or clipping limits to 0-77. Note any limits or fitted values outside the usable score scale and qualify their interpretation.

interpretation.mean: The confidence interval quantifies uncertainty about the conditional mean score for this predictor profile.
interpretation.individual: The prediction interval targets one new independent eligible participant with the same predictors. Its width includes the residual variation of an individual score.
interpretation.calibration: Both intervals are nominal 95% classical OLS intervals. Exact calibration relies on an adequate linear mean and independent, homoskedastic normal errors, including an independent new observation from the same conditional distribution for prediction. The observed asymmetry and variation in residual spread warrant treating the limits as model-based approximations, particularly for an individual score.
interpretation.hc3: HC3 remains a companion for coefficient uncertainty. The classical individual prediction interval uses the pooled residual variance as specified in the plan.
interpretation.scope: An educational application to a fixed profile on observed support. Actual predictive coverage in new data remains unverified.

primary_test.method: Two-sided model-based OLS t test with n-p residual degrees of freedom.
primary_test.parameter: Adjusted linear-model mean score difference per 0.1 mm greater left thickness at the same age, recorded sex and education.
primary_test.decision_rule: Use the registered model-based test for the primary decision; report HC3 alongside it without selecting a covariance method by p-value.
primary_test.interpretation: The registered primary test does not reject a zero adjusted thickness coefficient at alpha=0.05. Interpret the estimate and both intervals in correct responses per 0.1 mm. Non-rejection does not establish no association or practical equivalence; no equivalence margin has been supplied. The result remains conditional on the model and sampling assumptions, with residual and influence review pending.

requirement_evidence.general_8: Retained model form and rationale recorded against Step 6 evidence.
requirement_evidence.general_9: Conditional mean and single-observation prediction intervals reported separately.
